name: Kokoro (kokoro-onnx)
notes: 2026-11-01: 82M-parameter TTS on ONNX Runtime for offline scratch or final voiceover.
2026-11-01: Pin onnxruntime and cache WAVs as fixtures. Python >=3.10,<3.14.

2026-11-15: Official release page labels model-files-v1.1 as latest; assets show August 2026 upload times. Release page does not state a package release version/date for current code; 0.6.0 is referenced in model notes.
summary: Python interface to Kokoro TTS models through ONNX Runtime. Given text, a voice bank and model files, it synthesizes waveform samples that can be written as WAV; model weights and voices are separate downloads. It offers a compact local inference route, with multiple voice and precision variants, without requiring a hosted speech service.
use_when: Generate local speech audio from text with ONNX models and selectable voices
Use over hosted TTS when offline inference and local model control matter
avoid_when: Use Piper when broader voice and language coverage matters and GPL-3.0 is acceptable
Use Kokoro upstream when ONNX export/runtime is not required
license: MIT (kokoro-onnx code); Apache-2.0 (Kokoro model, per project README)

install.macos: python3 -m pip install kokoro-onnx; download matching ONNX model and voice bank from project releases

assessment.rationale: The project documents Kokoro ONNX 0.6.0 functionality and showed 2026 activity/issues; latest model-files-v1.1 assets include 2026-08-18 uploads. Code is MIT and README identifies the Kokoro model as Apache-2.0. Models and voice banks remain separate downloads.
